description: Judge calibration set: hand-written answers with a KNOWN correct grade, used to measure the graders themselves. Each item reuses a question and its expected_facts from golden.json (by golden_id) and supplies a planted answer. 'label' is the grade a careful human gives. 'trap' names the mistake being tested. Run: python judge_calibration.py

items.answer: It was not the breaker, and there was no circuit overload. The pump simply wore out.
items.label: incorrect
items.why: Mentions breaker, circuit and overload only to deny them. A substring check passes it.
